mod.name: Better Repair
mod.description: Set how much cardboard the repair table holds and how much a new day brings back, or make it unlimited.

setting.Cardboard.Unlimited.description: The repair table never runs out of cardboard. The host decides for everyone.
setting.Cardboard.Stock.description: How many sheets of cardboard the repair table holds. The table shows up to three, the rest waits in stock. 3 is the game's amount. The host decides for everyone.
setting.Cardboard.Refill.description: What a new day brings: the full stock, like in the game, or a set number of sheets. The host decides for everyone.
setting.Cardboard.RefillAmount.description: Sheets added every new day when a set number is chosen above. The stock never grows above its size. The host decides for everyone.
setting.Messages.Enabled.description: Shows how much cardboard is left after a repair and how much a new day brought. Only for you.
